title: marketdata.tick v1
description: Published by market-data for every price change, on the subject md.tick.<SYMBOL>. High volume and short-lived: consumers that need the current price should keep the latest per symbol; a missed tick is superseded by the next one. seq increases by 1 per tick of a symbol, so a gap shows a consumer missed some.

sessionDate.description: The trading day this tick belongs to.

ts.description: Market time of the trade, IST.

emittedAt.description: Wall-clock time it was produced, UTC.
